components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #c94a2a; color: #fff; border: 2px solid #8a2a14; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #3a2812; font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translate(-1px,-1px); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #3a2812; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #f4e6c8; color: #2b1d0e; border: 2px solid #4a3518; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px 12px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #3a2812; font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .08s, box-shadow .08s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translate(-1px,-1px); box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #4a3518; }

components.name: Pinned Card
components.description: Index-card event surface with color strip.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #f4e6c8; border: 2px solid #4a3518; border-radius: 4px; padding: 8px; box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #3a2812; transform: rotate(-.8deg); width: 160px; } .ds-card-color { height: 5px; border-radius: 2px; margin-bottom: 6px; background: #c94a2a; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Bradley Hand', cursive; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; color: #2b1d0e; } .ds-card-date { font-family: 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #6b4f2a; margin-top: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.css: .ds-input { background: #f4e6c8; color: #2b1d0e; border: 2px solid #4a3518; border-radius: 4px; padding: 6px; font-size: 13px; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #3a2812; font-family: -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 3px solid #c94a2a; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview: A cork pin-board where history events are pinned index cards and causal relations are colored strings. The surface feels like a student's own evidence wall — warm, tactile, owned — not a neutral tool panel.
keyCharacteristics: Cork ground with pinhole texture; warm palette only.
Index-card surfaces with hard offset shadows and pushpins.
Colored string for relation arrows (red/blue/amber/green by type).
Handwritten-feel titles over printed mono meta.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Red is the only action color; blue/amber/green appear only as relation-type or state colors, never as decoration.

rules.name: The Hand-Over-Print Rule
rules.body: Titles are handwritten; meta and data are mono. Never swap.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; shadows appear as paper-on-cork depth, never as glow.

dos: Do use hard offset shadows (no blur) for paper-on-cork depth.
Do keep rotations subtle (±1deg) and reset on interaction.
Do use string colors only for relation type / state.
Do use handwritten titles over mono meta.
donts: Don't use 1px hairlines or neutral Tailwind grays.
Don't use blur shadows or glassmorphism.
Don't use string colors as decoration.
Don't make panels look like a generic dashboard.
